segments.text:
I.
IT cannot be! Is this the Heart
That ſwelled ſo late with mighty Joy?
Lord, if Thou needs muſt uſe thy Dart,
Spare thy own Gifts, and Sin deſtroy.

II.
The Greater World knows no Decay;
But thy Diviner World of Grace
A new Creator ev'ry Day
Thou ſuddenly doſt rear or raſe.

III.
Set up thy Kingdom in my Heart,
That all my Pow'rs thy Sway may own:
For ah! my Lord, if Thou depart,
Strait rebel Nature mounts thy Throne.

IV.
Tho' Heav'n be mov'd, may I remain
Stedfaſt, and centred firm on Thee:
Here ſix thy Court, and ſtill maintain
A ſtanding Majeſty in me!
